title: Service Providers API
description: The Service Providers API lets partners onboard service providers, track their application progress, and link them to the merchants they serve. Use it to submit company or individual service provider applications, follow each application through KYB and signing, and manage which service providers are active on a merchant account.

apis.heading: Create Service Provider
apis.description: Start a company service provider application under a partner. Supply the company's country and corporate identifier, and Surfboard returns an application record together with a hosted KYB (Know Your Business) link that the service provider completes to finish onboarding.

reqParams.name: country
reqParams.description: Two-letter ISO country code where the service provider is registered, for example 'SE'.

reqParams.name: organisation
reqParams.description: Company details for the service provider.

reqParams.name: corporateId
reqParams.description: Corporate registration number of the company, validated against the supplied country.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Details of the created service provider application.

resParams.name: applicationId
resParams.description: Unique identifier for the created service provider application.

resParams.name: webKybUrl
resParams.description: Hosted URL where the service provider completes the KYB (Know Your Business) verification.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Initiate Individual Service Provider Onboarding
apis.description: Begin onboarding an individual service provider for a specific merchant. Surfboard sends the individual through a signing flow and returns the application and signing session so you can track the agreement to completion. Optionally attach fee configuration that applies to the service provider.

reqParams.name: email
reqParams.description: Email address of the individual service provider being onboarded.

reqParams.name: countryCode
reqParams.description: Two-letter ISO country code where the service provider is based, for example 'SE'.

reqParams.name: merchantId
reqParams.description: Identifier of the merchant the individual service provider will be associated with.

reqParams.name: spType
reqParams.description: Type of service provider being onboarded. Included only when provided.

reqParams.name: config
reqParams.description: Optional fee configuration applied to the service provider. Included only when provided.

reqParams.name: feePercentage
reqParams.description: Percentage fee taken from each applicable transaction.

reqParams.name: feeFixedAmount
reqParams.description: Fixed fee amount in the smallest currency unit taken from each applicable transaction.

reqParams.name: deductApplicableTransactionFee
reqParams.description: Whether the applicable transaction fee is deducted from the service provider.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Details of the initiated individual onboarding.

resParams.name: applicationId
resParams.description: Unique identifier for the individual service provider application.

resParams.name: signingLink
resParams.description: Hosted URL where the individual signs the service provider agreement.

resParams.name: signingSessionId
resParams.description: Identifier of the signing session used to track the agreement.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Current status of the onboarding application.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Get All Service Provider Applications
apis.description: Retrieve every service provider application under a partner, optionally filtered by application type. Use this to monitor onboarding and renewal progress across all of a partner's service providers.
apis.query: To filter results, pass the optional query param applicationType. Supported values are ONBOARDING and RENEWAL. Provide a single value or a comma-separated list such as ONBOARDING,RENEWAL. When omitted, ONBOARDING applications are returned.

reqParams.name: applicationType
reqParams.description: Filters applications by type. Provide a single value or a comma-separated list such as 'ONBOARDING,RENEWAL'. Defaults to 'ONBOARDING' when not supplied. Passed as a query parameter.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: List of service provider applications under the partner.

resParams.name: applicationId
resParams.description: Unique identifier of the application.

resParams.name: country
resParams.description: Two-letter ISO country code where the service provider is registered.

resParams.name: corporateId
resParams.description: Corporate registration number of the service provider.

resParams.name: applicationStatus
resParams.description: Current status of the application.

resParams.name: createdAt
resParams.description: ISO timestamp of when the application was created.

resParams.name: lastUpdatedAt
resParams.description: ISO timestamp of when the application was last updated.

resParams.name: webKybUrl
resParams.description: Hosted URL where the service provider completes KYB verification, when available.

resParams.name: legalName
resParams.description: Legal name of the service provider, when available.

resParams.name: endDate
resParams.description: ISO timestamp marking the end date of the application, when available.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Fetch Service Provider Application Status
apis.description: Retrieve the current status of a single service provider application by its ID. Use this to check where an application sits in the onboarding lifecycle and to obtain the resulting service provider ID once the application is approved.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Current status details of the application.

resParams.name: onboardingStatus
resParams.description: Current onboarding status of the application, null if onboarding has not started.

resParams.name: applicationStatus
resParams.description: Current status of the application.

resParams.name: serviceProviderId
resParams.description: Identifier of the created service provider once the application is approved, null while still pending.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Link Service Provider to Merchant
apis.description: Associate an existing service provider with a merchant so the service provider becomes active on that merchant account. Use this once a service provider has been onboarded to start routing the merchant's applicable business through it.

reqParams.name: serviceProviderId
reqParams.description: Identifier of the service provider to link to the merchant.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Unlink Service Provider from Merchant
apis.description: Remove the association between a service provider and a merchant so the service provider is no longer active on that merchant account. Use this to stop routing the merchant's business through a service provider.

reqParams.name: serviceProviderId
reqParams.description: Identifier of the service provider to unlink from the merchant.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Fetch Service Providers for Merchant
apis.description: Retrieve the service providers currently active on a merchant account. Use this to see which service providers a merchant is linked to and whether each link is active.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Active service providers linked to the merchant.

resParams.name: activeServiceProviders
resParams.description: List of service providers active on the merchant account.

resParams.name: merchantId
resParams.description: Identifier of the merchant the service provider is linked to.

resParams.name: partnerId
resParams.description: Identifier of the partner that owns the merchant.

resParams.name: isActive
resParams.description: Whether the link between the service provider and the merchant is currently active.

resParams.name: serviceProvider
resParams.description: Summary of the linked service provider, null if the details are unavailable.

resParams.name: id
resParams.description: Unique identifier of the service provider.

resParams.name: name
resParams.description: Name of the service provider.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Fetch Service Providers for Partner
apis.description: Retrieve all service providers registered under a partner, including their company details, contact information, and address. Use this to review the full roster of service providers a partner manages.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Service providers registered under the partner.

resParams.name: serviceProviders
resParams.description: List of service providers under the partner.

resParams.name: serviceProviderId
resParams.description: Unique identifier of the service provider.

resParams.name: personId
resParams.description: Identifier of the associated person, null for company service providers.

resParams.name: corporateId
resParams.description: Corporate registration number of the service provider.

resParams.name: nationalId
resParams.description: National identification number, null when not applicable.

resParams.name: name
resParams.description: Name of the service provider, null when not specified.

resParams.name: address
resParams.description: Registered address of the service provider, null if unavailable.

resParams.name: addressLine1
resParams.description: First line of the address.

resParams.name: city
resParams.description: City of the address.

resParams.name: countryCode
resParams.description: Two-letter ISO country code of the address.

resParams.name: postalCode
resParams.description: Postal code of the address.

resParams.name: phoneNumber
resParams.description: Contact phone number of the service provider, null if unavailable.

resParams.name: number
resParams.description: Phone number of the service provider.

resParams.name: code
resParams.description: Country dialing code of the phone number.

resParams.name: role
resParams.description: Role associated with the phone number, null when not specified.

resParams.name: email
resParams.description: Email address of the service provider.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.
